meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and I'd like to know why my son's mark was changed before anyone called me.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Owen found out from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of a class. What do you actually have, Hale?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
I'm writing that line down. A misquoted line is a mistake in an essay, Hale, and it doesn't prove anything about who wrote it. Did anyone ask Owen where it came from before the mark went in?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence. "It seems to run in the family." I'm writing that down, Hale, and the principal will be reading it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal involved, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: owning in one sentence that you entered the zero before calling her gave a small sign of ground, because it was plain and you moved on.
What cost ground: bringing up Claire and saying it runs in the family sent her cold and put the principal back on the table, because it was a remark about the family and not evidence.
Try next time: when she asked whether anyone had spoken to Owen about the misquoted line, answer that directly and then offer the supervised reassessment from the school's own procedure, with nothing going on his record.
